# The emulator core (staged atari800 + host layer), the FujiNet cartridge and
# the session layer.
a52_add_core(atari800_core "${ATARI800_GEN}")

# ---- a52_cart: the FujiNet Atari 5200 cartridge (cart/fujinet_cart.c, a C
# transposition of the firmware's MAME device) over the cartridge firmware's
# OWN sources, staged verbatim into cart/fuji-generated by
# cmake/StageFujiProto.cmake (never patched; the staged fujitcp.c is not
# compiled: cart/fujitcp_host.c is its portable, abortable twin).
set(FUJI_GEN "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/core/cart/fuji-generated")
if(NOT EXISTS "${FUJI_GEN}/fuji_mailbox.h")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Staged FujiNet sources are missing: cmake/StageFujiProto.cmake "
                      "should have produced them (re-run with -DFUJI_RESTAGE=ON).")
endif()
add_library(a52_cart STATIC
  cart/fujinet_cart.c cart/fujitcp_host.c
  ${FUJI_GEN}/fujimail.c ${FUJI_GEN}/fujibus.c ${FUJI_GEN}/fuji_cfg.c
  ${FUJI_GEN}/fuji_crc.c ${FUJI_GEN}/a52map.c ${FUJI_GEN}/a52map_db.c
  ${FUJI_GEN}/fuji_load.c)
set_target_properties(a52_cart PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 11 POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
target_include_directories(a52_cart PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cart" "${FUJI_GEN}")
target_compile_definitions(a52_cart PRIVATE _GNU_SOURCE _DEFAULT_SOURCE)
target_link_libraries(a52_cart PUBLIC Threads::Threads)
if(WIN32)
  target_link_libraries(a52_cart PUBLIC ws2_32)
else()
  target_link_libraries(a52_cart PUBLIC m)
endif()
set_property(SOURCE cart/fujinet_cart.c cart/fujitcp_host.c APPEND PROPERTY COMPILE_OPTIONS
  "$<$<C_COMPILER_ID:GNU,Clang,AppleClang>:-Wall;-Wextra>")

# the host: emulation thread, pacing, audio ring, frames (no SDL)
add_library(a52_host STATIC atari800/A52Host.cpp)
set_target_properties(a52_host PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
target_include_directories(a52_host PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/atari800")
target_link_libraries(a52_host PUBLIC atari800_core a52_cart)
target_compile_options(a52_host PRIVATE $<$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:GNU,Clang,AppleClang>:-Wall -Wextra>)

add_executable(a52_headless tools/a52_headless.c)
target_link_libraries(a52_headless PRIVATE atari800_core)

if(A52_AB_TEST)
  a52_add_core(atari800_core_stock "${ATARI800_STOCK}" STOCK)
  add_executable(a52_headless_stock tools/a52_headless.c)
  target_link_libraries(a52_headless_stock PRIVATE atari800_core_stock)
  # the A/B build of the patched core: deterministic too
  a52_add_core(atari800_core_det "${ATARI800_GEN}")
  target_compile_definitions(atari800_core_det PUBLIC A52_DETERMINISTIC)
  add_executable(a52_headless_det tools/a52_headless.c)
  target_link_libraries(a52_headless_det PRIVATE atari800_core_det)
endif()

# ---- ROM images a developer build embeds (never shipped; COMPLIANCE.md)
option(WITH_A5200_ROMS "Embed the ROM images in tools/roms (NOT redistributable)" OFF)
find_package(Python3 COMPONENTS Interpreter REQUIRED)
set(A52_ROMS_C "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/roms_embedded.c")
if(WITH_A5200_ROMS)
  file(GLOB _a52_rom_files CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/roms/*")
  add_custom_command(OUTPUT "${A52_ROMS_C}"
    COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/roms/embed-roms.py"
            "${A52_ROMS_C}" "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/roms"
    DEPENDS "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/roms/embed-roms.py" ${_a52_rom_files} VERBATIM)
else()
  add_custom_command(OUTPUT "${A52_ROMS_C}"
    COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/roms/embed-roms.py"
            --none "${A52_ROMS_C}"
    DEPENDS "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/roms/embed-roms.py" VERBATIM)
endif()

# ---- a52_session: the frontend contract (needs SDL3)
find_package(SDL3 CONFIG QUIET)
if(NOT SDL3_FOUND)
  message(STATUS "a52_session: SDL3 not found -- core and its tests only")
  add_subdirectory(tests)
  return()
endif()

set(A52_SESSION_C_SOURCES
  src/settings.c src/paths.c src/prefs.c src/roms.c src/zipread.c
  src/bindings.c src/hid_keys.c src/audio_sdl.c src/gamepad_sdl.c src/fujinet_runtime.c
  debugger/fujitrace.c
  "${A52_ROMS_C}")
set(A52_SESSION_CXX_SOURCES src/session.cpp src/input.cpp src/media.cpp src/debug.cpp)

add_library(a52_session STATIC ${A52_SESSION_C_SOURCES} ${A52_SESSION_CXX_SOURCES})
set_target_properties(a52_session PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
target_include_directories(a52_session PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
target_include_directories(a52_session PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/debugger")
target_link_libraries(a52_session PUBLIC a52_host a52_cart SDL3::SDL3 ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
set_source_files_properties(${A52_SESSION_C_SOURCES} ${A52_SESSION_CXX_SOURCES}
  PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-Wall;-Wextra")
set_source_files_properties("${A52_ROMS_C}" PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-w")
target_compile_definitions(a52_session PRIVATE
  A52_DEV_FUJINET_OUT="${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/fujinet/work/out"
  A52_INSTALL_DATADIR="${CMAKE_INSTALL_FULL_DATADIR}/fujinet-go-atari5200"
  A52_INSTALL_LIBDIR="${CMAKE_INSTALL_FULL_LIBDIR}/fujinet-go-atari5200")

add_subdirectory(tests)
